how_to_use: status 'observed': the 12 seeds exactly as the CFP announced them on Selection Day (seed 1 first, the feed's team spellings), with source_url and announced_at; the committee proxy is then never used and completed playoff games come from the schedule feed. status 'scenario': a hypothetical bracket whose assumptions are listed; every output it produces is labelled CONDITIONAL on it. status 'none': before Selection Day.
